_README: SLICE 7 (Track O red-team) synthetic combat logs for the Track D telemetry writers under PARTIAL FIGHTS and DEATH MID-WRITE. Event shapes copied from the real emit sites: aura_applied/aura_wasted tier0/engine/reactions.py:65,:75; reaction :164; salon_upkeep/salon_tick tier0/engine/effects.py:2421,:2428; encore_end tier0/engine/combat.py:857; fanfare_turn combat.py:508; fanfare_read/gain_fanfare tier0/engine/resources.py:258,:87. Every log is one FIGHT, the unit model.py:563-597 reduces.

aura_enemy_dies_mid_aura._what: Hydro lands on enemy A at turn 2; A dies at turn 2 (the engine emits NO enemy-death event, effects.py:376-384). The fight runs to turn 20 against enemy B with no further hydro. Max real span of an unconsumed aura is AURA_DURATION_TURNS=2 (+ the applying turn) = turns 2-4.

aura_enemy_survives_aura_expires._what: Control for the above: the same application, but the target lives, so tick_auras emits aura_wasted at turn 4 and the interval closes honestly.

aura_complete_fight._what: A ten-turn fight the player WON, two hydro applications, both consumed by a reaction.

aura_partial_fight_death_turn_1._what: The fight the run DIED in: one turn, no hydro yet. model.py:587 appends this trace before the `not fight_won` exit at :643, so it lands in the cohort as a whole fight.

encore_death_mid_upkeep._what: Three-member stage; the player dies after the second member ticks, so effects.py:2423-2425 breaks the loop and the third salon_tick never lands. encore_end IS still emitted on the death path (combat.py:856).

encore_complete_upkeep._what: Control: the same stage ticking all three members and the fight ending normally.

encore_gain_without_end._what: A fight that generated and spent Encore but emitted neither salon_upkeep nor encore_end. aggregate()'s liveness filter drops it whole.

fanfare_reads_without_turn_snapshot._what: A fight carrying a read, a 60%-overflow gain and a spend, but no fanfare_turn snapshot. aggregate()'s `live` filter (turns > 0) discards the whole trace, and the overflow it carried disappears.

fanfare_long_fight_pinned._what: Twenty turns held at the cap. Paired with the next entry to show mean_held_fraction/peak_fraction averaging per-combat ratios instead of pooling.

fanfare_one_turn_death._what: A one-turn fight held at 0 -- the fight a run dies in.
